A bachelorette hangover kit is ` [Highlight start] a party favor pouch or box stocked with hydration, pain relief, and grooming essentials to help guests recover after a night out [Highlight end] ` . Most kits and favor bags cost between **$1 and $70** depending on whether you buy pre-filled pouches, themed boxes, or empty bags to customize yourself.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXW3F8b3IFeFCODcPTfXtea7CvygwEZBkRnE783vxetRDc0DOq4dIqtWXHotLPK2LfyV8Yb0V_MqfI-8LTqcrFEFpFFpd35tnt3HeFmrrw-JRf9Bb15fG5uAWUr60TW4B37-7zf5yvo6I4cneDIQf3zthok8gD)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXchhMY-ASBO6ud2QBPjitQ2_EqaLr886PjeUaUAZ3Ff8VjZd_WfDUbQmV1QNPZmgXt2XwdV5V3gKlfrAVFTq6Bb1eWca8QUZVftTwuTRodTQWAM75ifswu4mzExxzZ32fIVkeZeccfY0)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF11jNlx5ueNg_l0MQfAfneSz_El0aA4DelPRAXMZ7t_0gMZxxJgX33M5JDjf_esLW--rvESnW6QU_6FsoUBWTw0y22FOR30AYqeIx6x7PsW8wEiBvDK81S54KQ-RaYo8YTjDXcfjAoidhSHVEIcWHDZdLgee8B2qnkPUWLQ)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXaO6bxvzaekYYlSXGUd12DKjwIwsgmlnkUnZ9ofsMsz8VSY8WunjzIurbOua30DkceDLpvb-up2C1eJmwqEu9mRWQA2TPV-yymRtUEnWgupw5qfe4OLpAfDcPDyDszme1KyzEHyyCWH1YxXFzGGms)[[5]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:17209137748522524910,catalogid:1030783856267097550,gpcid:13101503010248572310,mid:576462375736529044&ibp=oshop)[[6]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:10956119305029801081,catalogid:3319730486446853209,gpcid:1671619466847578857,mid:576462875804751179&ibp=oshop)

### What to Put Inside

- **Hydration & Relief:** Electrolyte packets (like [Liquid I.V.](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462576459595183,imageDocid:10128521174687172242,gpcid:633602903548162757,headlineOfferDocid:1376781439152858314,catalogid:10511523016409341249,productDocid:18160173188712481673,rds:PC_10893961444779289638%7CPROD_PC_10893961444779289638&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjDksLvh6CYAxVMTDABHX5bA5QQxa4PegYIAggIEA4) or [Pedialyte](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462865244839108,imageDocid:12998035355078904769,gpcid:13629127347452995203,headlineOfferDocid:61045229625121798,catalogid:12592473235530464502,productDocid:9056715863448502116,rds:PC_13629127347452995203%7CPROD_PC_13629127347452995203&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjDksLvh6CYAxVMTDABHX5bA5QQxa4PegYIAggIEA8) ), pain relievers (Advil/Tylenol), antacids (Tums/Alka-Seltzer), and ginger chews.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXchhMY-ASBO6ud2QBPjitQ2_EqaLr886PjeUaUAZ3Ff8VjZd_WfDUbQmV1QNPZmgXt2XwdV5V3gKlfrAVFTq6Bb1eWca8QUZVftTwuTRodTQWAM75ifswu4mzExxzZ32fIVkeZeccfY0)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF11jNlx5ueNg_l0MQfAfneSz_El0aA4DelPRAXMZ7t_0gMZxxJgX33M5JDjf_esLW--rvESnW6QU_6FsoUBWTw0y22FOR30AYqeIx6x7PsW8wEiBvDK81S54KQ-RaYo8YTjDXcfjAoidhSHVEIcWHDZdLgee8B2qnkPUWLQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXaO6bxvzaekYYlSXGUd12DKjwIwsgmlnkUnZ9ofsMsz8VSY8WunjzIurbOua30DkceDLpvb-up2C1eJmwqEu9mRWQA2TPV-yymRtUEnWgupw5qfe4OLpAfDcPDyDszme1KyzEHyyCWH1YxXFzGGms)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXW3F8b3IFeFCODcPTfXtea7CvygwEZBkRnE783vxetRDc0DOq4dIqtWXHotLPK2LfyV8Yb0V_MqfI-8LTqcrFEFpFFpd35tnt3HeFmrrw-JRf9Bb15fG5uAWUr60TW4B37-7zf5yvo6I4cneDIQf3zthok8gD)
- **Freshness & Grooming:** Makeup remover wipes, pocket mouthwash or mints, lip balm/chapstick, hair ties or scrunchies, and mini deodorant or hand sanitizer.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXaO6bxvzaekYYlSXGUd12DKjwIwsgmlnkUnZ9ofsMsz8VSY8WunjzIurbOua30DkceDLpvb-up2C1eJmwqEu9mRWQA2TPV-yymRtUEnWgupw5qfe4OLpAfDcPDyDszme1KyzEHyyCWH1YxXFzGGms)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF11jNlx5ueNg_l0MQfAfneSz_El0aA4DelPRAXMZ7t_0gMZxxJgX33M5JDjf_esLW--rvESnW6QU_6FsoUBWTw0y22FOR30AYqeIx6x7PsW8wEiBvDK81S54KQ-RaYo8YTjDXcfjAoidhSHVEIcWHDZdLgee8B2qnkPUWLQ)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXW3F8b3IFeFCODcPTfXtea7CvygwEZBkRnE783vxetRDc0DOq4dIqtWXHotLPK2LfyV8Yb0V_MqfI-8LTqcrFEFpFFpd35tnt3HeFmrrw-JRf9Bb15fG5uAWUr60TW4B37-7zf5yvo6I4cneDIQf3zthok8gD)
- **Extras:** Under-eye gel patches, sleep eye masks, Band-Aids, stain remover wipes, and snacks or candy.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXW3F8b3IFeFCODcPTfXtea7CvygwEZBkRnE783vxetRDc0DOq4dIqtWXHotLPK2LfyV8Yb0V_MqfI-8LTqcrFEFpFFpd35tnt3HeFmrrw-JRf9Bb15fG5uAWUr60TW4B37-7zf5yvo6I4cneDIQf3zthok8gD)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXchhMY-ASBO6ud2QBPjitQ2_EqaLr886PjeUaUAZ3Ff8VjZd_WfDUbQmV1QNPZmgXt2XwdV5V3gKlfrAVFTq6Bb1eWca8QUZVftTwuTRodTQWAM75ifswu4mzExxzZ32fIVkeZeccfY0)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHEIkXXxGI4CKuLAYz5SJYt5tPDZ4v8p7VwykTWQCoR9iNBJVQfVg-OCETbgy-oBoc5GkVv54X9UmNOqto1NerZb6pkg8aWJ7yH3qzg-1G5Kq5_7nQbLhQpn6Otkn9cJF2t)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdAHEIkXXaO6bxvzaekYYlSXGUd12DKjwIwsgmlnkUnZ9ofsMsz8VSY8WunjzIurbOua30DkceDLpvb-up2C1eJmwqEu9mRWQA2TPV-yymRtUEnWgupw5qfe4OLpAfDcPDyDszme1KyzEHyyCWH1YxXFzGGms)

### Pre-Made vs. DIY Options

- **Pre-filled kits:** Ready-to-hand-out pouches save prep time—you can order customizable [Bride Tribe Events](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESrgEBxCJF13Tq9NhRAB8UoaEy9CGyoFsogWa1X4PWWrztIkg2_2F_DUtvmrCZO8w6mkUIp_6NyLARpiZP1EF1u3We1rA7R6MJ8DF6ZxebI9ovafdht45pfYPR1wpfO9Rso2gUmRPxaaeIDEkX9T2G4EIQKJ0wXOQ5YiO6Tu0pGySK3e4NhUu1mG9_moMCl57JlTFIKRmzwQUOTgPkqfCR_xOo56EsgISu3CR7LLFqwnI) recovery kits (minimum order of six) or grab a pre-packed [Amazon Premium Hangover Kit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF170bDyn-T7gsmb_SfRfhcALWOU8zWEMlMFJmls6XxFCPfON4QsEbGZQ80Iy3yFKka7pH0hiLguBXhIJQvnr-hfWezeX5htoqJ5cwtIrc0fI4iUDCIPJzYrit5syicQTPz9GBLR094ie4ZXJkTENSidsu1KNWFuO-63PVWA) pouch with nine essentials.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF170bDyn-T7gsmb_SfRfhcALWOU8zWEMlMFJmls6XxFCPfON4QsEbGZQ80Iy3yFKka7pH0hiLguBXhIJQvnr-hfWezeX5htoqJ5cwtIrc0fI4iUDCIPJzYrit5syicQTPz9GBLR094ie4ZXJkTENSidsu1KNWFuO-63PVWA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXXchhMY-ASBO6ud2QBPjitQ2_EqaLr886PjeUaUAZ3Ff8VjZd_WfDUbQmV1QNPZmgXt2XwdV5V3gKlfrAVFTq6Bb1eWca8QUZVftTwuTRodTQWAM75ifswu4mzExxzZ32fIVkeZeccfY0)
- **Empty bags & boxes:** Buying empty drawstring pouches, favor bags, or kraft boxes lets you tailor contents to your group. Options include [Pop Fizz (~$5.60).[[1]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:17209137748522524910,catalogid:1030783856267097550,gpcid:13101503010248572310,mid:576462375736529044&ibp=oshop)[[2]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:7266161337733826740,catalogid:11725897406002580075,gpcid:10981812753093206907,mid:576462873297700318&ibp=oshop)[[3]](https://www.google.com/search?q=product&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,productid:15945915078757054802,catalogid:5208634615163094711,gpcid:384696904517008639,mid:576462568256000595&ibp=oshop)

For more item ideas by category, check [The Knot](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXW3F8b3IFeFCODcPTfXtea7CvygwEZBkRnE783vxetRDc0DOq4dIqtWXHotLPK2LfyV8Yb0V_MqfI-8LTqcrFEFpFFpd35tnt3HeFmrrw-JRf9Bb15fG5uAWUr60TW4B37-7zf5yvo6I4cneDIQf3zthok8gD) , or see Kay + Co for tips on packing a shared essentials basket.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESegHEIkXXW3F8b3IFeFCODcPTfXtea7CvygwEZBkRnE783vxetRDc0DOq4dIqtWXHotLPK2LfyV8Yb0V_MqfI-8LTqcrFEFpFFpd35tnt3HeFmrrw-JRf9Bb15fG5uAWUr60TW4B37-7zf5yvo6I4cneDIQf3zthok8gD)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgAEBxCJF11jNlx5ueNg_l0MQfAfneSz_El0aA4DelPRAXMZ7t_0gMZxxJgX33M5JDjf_esLW--rvESnW6QU_6FsoUBWTw0y22FOR30AYqeIx6x7PsW8wEiBvDK81S54KQ-RaYo8YTjDXcfjAoidhSHVEIcWHDZdLgee8B2qnkPUWLQ)To help narrow down the best setup, share:

- **How many people** you're packing for and whether you prefer **pre-filled** or **DIY** 
- Your **budget per guest** and any **party theme** or destination
- Whether you want **individual bags/boxes** or a **shared basket**

Empty bags & boxes: Buying empty drawstring pouches, favor bags, or kraft boxes lets you tailor contents to your group. Options include Pop Fizz Designs 10-pack boxes (~$12.99), Plum Grove Design personalized kraft bags (~$23.25), or YourPartyBox.com drawstring bags (~$5.60). Pop Fizz Designs Plum Grove Design YourPartyBox.com Communal basket: Setting out bulk items in a shared basket or kitchen tray is an easy alternative if you want to cut costs and avoid leftover bags.
